text:
anika: Quick check — for the upcoming design partner cohort can we lock recruitment slots + agree acceptance criteria? Need invite cadence final by EOD Thu. TL;DR: 8 pilot seats, staggered start, 2-week feedback window. Thoughts?

sam: I think timeline overlaps with a few other pilots. Can we split into 2 waves (4 + 4) separated by 1 week? @lee would that break onboarding flows? :thinking_face:

lee: 2 waves is fine. Runtime onboarding is ~1 day. Main risk = partners asking for custom quantization/configs which we don't want to support in DP. Suggest adding a "no custom quant" clause to invites.

jordan: Also recommend a short live session in week1 to capture UX/edge-case pain early. Proposed: 30m onboarding + 45m structured feedback interview at end of week2.

priya: Success criteria proposal: 1) 4/8 partners complete the full feedback checklist, 2) avg 95th-percentile latency <= 250ms on our dedicated test env, 3) no critical quality regressions vs baseline (automated eval delta <= 2%) and human-rated acceptability >= 3/5.

sam: +1 to metrics. For evals we need a lightweight hook: ask partners to run 3 canonical prompts and submit outputs. Compare embedding-similarity + 3-point human rating per prompt. Keeps burden low.

lee: embedding-sim + human rating works. I'll add tracing flags and a per-partner dashboard for latency + token counts. Need partners to opt-in to redacted logs sharing in the invite.

anika: Action items: Sam — draft invite copy with the "no custom quant" and data-sharing clause, Jordan — schedule onboarding + feedback slots, Lee — add tracing flags & dashboard, Priya — lock final success metrics. I'll send final invites Fri AM.

deploy-bot: Reminder — scheduled sends must not exceed 500 invites/hour quota. :robot_face:

sam: Got it, will draft and ping for review in #product-review.
